findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. Ensure that all food contact surfaces remain free of contaminants at all times. 

Multiple nozzles for the drive thru fountain drink machine were observed soiled during this inspection. Per the PIC they should be being cleaned every night as part of the closing procedure. This appears to not be happening. The PIC was shown a nozzle and instructed to clean them.  All of the nozzles were removed during this inspection and cleaned (wash/rinse/sanitize) to correct the violation.  The PIC should review cleaning procedures with the relevant staff to ensure that this is not an issue again.

findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. Ensure that all food contact surfaces remain free of contaminants at all times. 

1) Multiple nozzles for the drive thru fountain drink machine are observed soiled during this inspection. Per the PIC they should be being cleaned every night as part of the closing procedure. This appears to not be happening. The PIC was shown a nozzle and instructed to clean them.  All of the nozzles were removed during this inspection and cleaned (wash/rinse/sanitize) to correct the violation. 2) The inside of the ice chute in the customer area is observed with pink slime/green and black mold on the inside of the chute in cracks where the sides of the chute meet. The PIC was told and an employee instructed to clean with a sani rag to correct.  The PIC should review cleaning procedures with the relevant staff to ensure that this is not an issue again.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.citation_text:
3-307.11 Miscellaneous Sources of Contamination. FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 - 3-306. 

During this inspection an employee was observed to probe multiple food items throughout the kitchen as part of their scheduled checks. As they were doing so they were only observed to wipe off the probe with paper towels. The probe should be sanitized between uses to ensure food safety is maintained. All items were within safe temperature ranges per inspector checks. The situation was discussed and education conducted with the PIC. Ensure that all items being used for multiple items and stored out of use for long periods of time between uses are sanitized between uses.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.citation_text:
6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

What appears to be the remains of someone’s meal was observed on top of the in use soda syrups in the back of the facility. The PIC was shown and had the items removed to correct the immediate violation. Ensure that all foods are consumed and stored so that contamination of foods or food contact items intended for consumers is not a concern.

findings.title: Allergen awareness notice
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625/3.08(a). Food Allergy awareness. (a) A restaurant shall display a notice indicating to consumers that any information regarding food allergies must be communicated to an employee of the restaurant.

On arrival an allergen notice was not observed at the facility. The situation was discussed with the PIC and they were unaware of one posted at the facility or on the menu. A notice given during this inspection to correct. Ensure that an allergen notice is observable by customers at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: (A) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned before each use, each time there is a change in work, between uses of raw FOODS to RTE FOODS, before using FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE, and when contamination has occurred. (C) 

1) Multiple pans stored on the shelves as ready for use are observed with either baked on debris or greasy/oily residues. 2) A scoop is observed stored ready for use with a white stringy substance on the handle. The PIC was shown and moved the items to dish for re-cleaning. Education should be conducted with the dish washers to ensure that the dishes are always completely cleaned prior to storage and use.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple nozzles on the drive thru fountain drink machine are observed with significant filth build up on the inside of the nozzles. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean and maintain clean at all times. The nozzles were removed and washed during this inspection to correct the immediate violation.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. 

The shelf above the prep line has significant food debris and dust observed. This is where stacks of single service containers are stored prior to use out of their packaging. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean this location and maintain it clean moving forward to protect the food contact surfaces from contamination.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. 

The metal sheet between the mop sink and the wall is pulling away from the wall under the faucets. This is exposing a gap that is not reasonably cleanable. The PIC is instructed to reseal the metal to the wall and ensure a smooth and easily cleanable surface moving forward.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. 

During this inspection the PIC could not show a CFPM certification to the inspector. Verification was available that the course was completed earlier this month but the certificate has not arrived/become available online at this time. No other employees currently at the facility have a CFPM certificate. Ensure that there are enough CFPMs on staff to cover all shifts and that copies of the certificates are available for observation at the facility at all times.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  

An employee was observed to handle a clean nozzle assembly for the fountain drink machine and install it with their bare hand and without hand washing. Breaking down boxes (that were on the floor) took place prior. The situation was discussed with the PIC and the nozzle replaced, taking care not to contaminate the item during installation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

1) There is a hole in the ceiling tiles in the dry storage area. Replace the damaged tile. The PIC indicated that this was were an old camera used to be. The tile should have been replaced at the time that the camera was removed. 2) The doors to the cabinets under the fountain drink machine in the customer seating area has two sections chipped away that expose the particle board. Repair or reseal so that there is a smooth and easily cleanable surface. 3) A hole is at shoulder level in the wall between the dry storage and walk-ins. Repair so that the surface is smooth and easily cleanable.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. 

On arrival none of the employees currently at this facility have a Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM) certification. Per the current PIC, the GM walked out Saturday and took several managers with him. A remaining CFPM arrived during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

The bag of sanitizer concentrate used for filling the three part sink and bucket in the facility is observed empty at the beginning of this inspection. The bag was changed (the truck earlier today restocked it) and new buckets/ sink made in an attempt to correct the violation. After replacing the bag, the concentrations were still not coming out correctly on the inspector’s or facility’s test strips. At this time the solution is being manually made to reach the correct concentration for food contact surfaces.

(D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple nozzles of the fountain drink machine next to the drive thru window are soiled. Pink slime was observed around the Pepsi nozzles and accumulated brown build up on multiple others. PIC was shown and the Items disassembled, cleaned, sanitized and re-installed during this inspection to correct. PIC is instructed to maintain clean moving foreword. PIC indicated that overnight soaking as well as daily cleaning would be the standard practice moving foreword.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 

The ceiling tiles around the vents in the kitchen and prep areas have a significant amount of dust. PIC is instructed to clean often enough so as to maintain clean.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment: Single service forks available for customers to pick up are presented mixed directions (handles and fork ends) so that picking up the handle of one fork may result in contamination of the food contact end of another fork. Discard forks already available to customers. With clean, gloved hands, arrange single service utensils so that handles are up.
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11 (B) UTENSILS not prewrapped shall be presented so only handles are touched by EMPLOYEES and/or CONSUMERS. [C]

1st REPEAT: PIC has not completed ANSI-approved allergen awareness training. All CFMs must complete allergen training. Keep certificates on file.

findings.comment: Observed automatic soap dispenser in the mens restroom to be not functioning. Facility did not have extra batteries on site, but sent an employee to purchase extra batteries so the soap dispenser will properly dispense. Employee returned and replaced batteries before completion of the inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.
